description: Open source repositories with NO BOUNTIES that still credit reporters with CVEs (GitHub CNA or MITRE), ordered by newest stable release first.

repos.name: redis/redis
repos.description: In-memory data structure store used as a database, cache and message broker. No bug bounty: reports go through the Redis Vulnerability Disclosure Program on HackerOne, which pays no rewards, and fixes are published as CVE-tagged advisories crediting the reporter. Latest stable release: 8.10.0 (2026-07-29).

repos.name: go-gitea/gitea
repos.description: Self-hosted lightweight Git service. No bug bounty program; vulnerabilities are reported privately via GitHub security advisories and published as GHSA entries with CVEs assigned by the GitHub CNA and public reporter credit (e.g. CVE-2026-60004). Latest stable release: v1.27.1 (2026-07-28).

repos.name: xwiki/xwiki-platform
repos.description: Generic enterprise wiki platform offering runtime services for applications built on top of it. No bug bounty program; hundreds of published GHSA advisories carry CVEs assigned by the GitHub CNA and credit the reporter (e.g. CVE-2026-34151). Latest stable release: xwiki-platform-18.6.0 (2026-07-27).
